question: What do the four PRS checklist rows test?

options.label: Proposed reading (Recommended)
options.consequence: PRS-C criteria: every closing issue has AC rows in Given/When/Then; PRS-L measurable: each row names an observable or a number with its unit; PRS-S scope: the body's scope boundaries name what is out; PRS-M markers: no open OQ row and every AS assumption carried into the body. Pass = all four answered yes by the reviewer, not the author

options.label: Defer HA#503
options.consequence: leave the issue parked until the maintainer writes the four definitions
